selection_policy: Seventy-five high-activity public software repositories spanning JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, JVM, .NET, mobile, infrastructure, and data systems. The fifteen whole-repository test projects were not present in the v3 corpus and are frozen before any v4 test extraction or label inspection.

label_rule.unit: repository UTC hour with at least one public issue-opened or issue-comment-created event
label_rule.candidate_timestamp: The end of the UTC hour. Features use only activity strictly before that timestamp. A positive is assigned only to the hour in which its issue was opened, and confirmation must occur later.

sources_in_precedence_order.definition: A non-bot actor other than the reporter closes the issue as completed while its labels contain a bug, regression, defect, crash, panic, or correctness marker. The close must occur after the candidate timestamp and within the frozen lookahead.
A later merged pull request uses a closing keyword to reference the issue number. The merge event must occur after the candidate timestamp and within the frozen lookahead.

A later non-bot OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR comment matches the committed substantive acknowledgment classifier. The comment must occur after the candidate timestamp and within the frozen lookahead.

feature_policy.phase: same UTC hour and weekday/weekend class
feature_policy.text: cross-thread token and character-shingle similarity from strictly pre-candidate issue activity
feature_policy.reuse: The v3 burst and coherence feature families are reused unchanged so the population and label expansion, not a feature rewrite, is the v4 intervention.

model_policy.selection: Leave-one-repository-out predictions on train repositories only.
model_policy.threshold_selection: maximize train OOF row-level F1, then precision, recall, ROC AUC, and the higher threshold
model_policy.repository_balance: Every training repository receives equal total weight; positive and negative classes receive equal weight within repositories containing both classes.
